comments.body:
Any error will trigger, e.g.:
```py
import sys
import time

time_tuple = time.localtime()

def hook(event, *args):
    pass
sys.addaudithook(hook)

raise ValueError
```

I'm guessing something to do with the time module.

Oh, it's just the audithook preventing proper clean up, simplified repro:
```py
import sys
import time

time_tuple = time.localtime()

def hook(event, *args):
    pass
sys.addaudithook(hook)
pass
```

Even without errors we have the same result:

```python
import sys
import time

hook = lambda a, b: None
sys.addaudithook(hook)
t = time.localtime()
```

I can reproduce this issue with ASAN on 3.14 and main, and not on 3.13.
I have a patch to clear audit hooks before destroying modules to avoid reference cycles, fixes the issue.
